_meanings:
(Mīmāṃsā) A rule of interpretation according to
 which a detail that cannot properly find connection with the primary or
 main matter should be understood as belonging to a subsidiary thereof.
 This is an exception to the {#miTo'sambanDanyAya#} (<ab>q. v.</ab>). This is discussed
 by Jaimini and Śabara at <ls>MS. 3. 1. 23</ls>.
